news.title: Sidharth and Tamannaah's Supernatural Film Reports Collection Surge
news.summary: Despite facing negative initial reactions upon its Friday release, the folklore-inspired fantasy drama The Vvaan has reportedly registered a pickup in its theatrical earnings. The makers state that the movie has accumulated ₹23.5 crore globally, with the second day showing better domestic numbers than the premiere.

news.title: Low-Budget Phenomenon Hanuman Ansh Crosses Massive Milestone
news.summary: Produced on a modest budget of just ₹2 crore, the indie feature Hanuman Ansh has powered past the ₹400 crore gross mark during its 52nd day in cinemas. The film continues to maintain a steady theatrical run both domestically and overseas, turning into an unprecedented box office surprise.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Eyes Robust Opening Weekend Despite Criticism
news.summary: Nani's latest cinematic outing opened to widespread negative reviews and social media trolling, yet managed to pull strong crowds into theatres, particularly across Telangana. Fueled by an extended holiday weekend, trade analysts anticipate the project will comfortably surpass ₹150 crore in gross collections by the end of its opening days.

news.title: First Single From Venkatesh and Trivikram Collaboration Unveiled
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming action-family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam have released its opening track, Narayanamma, composed by Thaman S and featuring a special appearance by Dimple Hayathi. Headlined by Venkatesh and directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Ranbir and Alia's Big-Budget Period Drama Locks Low Digital Rights Amount
news.summary: The upcoming historical project Love & War, featuring a high-profile cast under Sanjay Leela Bhansali's direction, has secured a surprising digital streaming agreement. Trade circles are openly discussing the modest valuation of the platform deal, which has raised eyebrows given the production's massive scale. The theatrical release is officially locked for January 21, 2027.

news.title: Pan-India Star Unveils Sneak Peek Into Upcoming Romantic Drama
news.summary: Prominent actor Prabhas shared an intriguing preview of the upcoming romantic film titled Romeo Juliet, starring Havish and Visakha Dhiman. Directed by Bhargav Macharla, the project recently revealed a glimpse featuring intense character dynamics and weapon selections. The film is scheduled to hit theaters on October 23, 2026, coinciding with the star's birthday.

news.title: Makers Drop Intriguing Preview for Psychological Romance Kaasu
news.summary: The upcoming multi-lingual film Kaasu has released a stylish introductory video focusing on its lead characters played by Shree Nandu and Indu Kumar. Directed by P.S. Harshavardhan and backed by AKR Dream Pictures LLP, the narrative examines how obsession and wealth challenge deep-rooted romance. The project is slated for a pan-Indian release across multiple languages including Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi.

news.title: Shared Responsibility in Film Outcomes
news.summary: The outcome of any movie relies on the collective efforts of the entire team, from actors and directors to technicians and producers. A project's success or failure cannot be pinned on a single individual since every craft contributes to its final fate.

news.title: First Single From Aadarsha Kutumbam - AK47 Released
news.summary: The musical campaign for the Victory Venkatesh starrer Aadarsha Kutumbam - AK47 has commenced with the launch of the track Narayanamma. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and composed by Thaman S, the energetic festive number features vocals by Ram Miriyala and Prabha alongside lead star Dimple Hayati.

news.title: Prabhas Launches Story Reveal Video for Gen-Z Rom-Com Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Rebel Star Prabhas has unveiled the story reveal glimpse for the upcoming youthful movie Romeo Juliet, starring Harshit and Vishaka Dhiman. Directed by Bhargav Mucharla, the film satirizes modern dating trends and situationships, and is scheduled to hit theaters on October 23.

news.title: Rebel Star Prabhas Unveils Story Glimpse of Romeo Juliet
news.summary: The makers of Romeo Juliet have released a unique story reveal video introducing the film's unconventional plot surrounding contemporary youth dynamics. Directed by Bhargav Macharla and starring Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman, the movie is slated for an October 23 theatrical release.

news.title: Venkatesh's Adarsha Kutumbam kickstarts musical promotions with Narayanamma track
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Venkatesh's upcoming family entertainer Adarsha Kutumbam has officially begun with the release of its first single, Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman, the energetic dance track features lead actor Venkatesh alongside Dimple Hayathi, Sreenidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on October 9.

news.title: First single Narayanamma from Adarsha Kutumbam drops online
news.summary: Makers of the much-awaited Telugu release Adarsha Kutumbam have unveiled the film's opening single, Narayanamma. The mass dance number showcases energetic performances by Venkatesh, Dimple Hayathi, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj, set to a tune composed by Thaman and lyrics written by Ramajogayya Sastry. Bankrolled by Haarika & Hassine Creations, the Trivikram directorial heads to theaters on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Malayalam blockbuster Bethlehem Kudumba confirms digital streaming date
news.summary: The Malayalam industry hit romantic comedy Bethlehem Kudumba, starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, has officially scheduled its digital premiere on JioHotstar. Directed by Girish AD, the massive box office success will become available to stream starting October 2, 2026, with a multi-language release that includes Telugu. The film features supporting performances from a large ensemble cast and was produced under the banner of Bhavana Studios.

news.title: Suriya Advises Admirers to Ignore Digital Trolls
news.summary: During a recent interaction with his fan club members, Tamil actor Suriya suggested they steer clear of online negativity and controversies. He emphasized that wasting energy on critics is pointless and urged them to channel their focus entirely towards personal productivity and spreading positivity.

news.title: Anticipation Mounts for Rajinikanth's Upcoming Action Sequel
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's high-stakes sequel Jailer 2 is gearing up for an October 15 release with massive pre-release business targets. While trade circles wonder if the film can crack Kollywood's elusive 1000-crore milestone, the ongoing promotional campaign has received a mixed response and requires a stronger push.

news.title: Speculation Rises Around Mahesh Babu's Post-Varanasi Project
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu wraps up shooting and begins dubbing for SS Rajamouli's Varanasi ahead of its April 2027 release, rumors about his next venture are swirling. Recent industry chatter links director Lokesh Kanagaraj to the superstar following a collaboration announcement between G Squad and Mythri Movie Makers, though no official confirmation has been made.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Backlash Over Controversial Line
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela addressed online trolling regarding a controversial dialogue in their steady box-office performer, The Paradise. The filmmaker explained that an intended ironic backstory was edited out to control the runtime, which left the line feeling abrupt and misunderstood by viewers.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Embraces Vintage Fashion in Her Latest Shoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu has showcased a striking retro-themed look in a fresh photoshoot, donning a black-and-gold floral mini dress, voluminous curls, and gold heels against a vintage bathroom background. On the professional front, her films Advocate Raavi and Gandhari faced box-office struggles earlier in 2026, but she is currently occupied with filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she portrays ACP Komal Sharma.

news.title: Jr NTR to Get Back on the Sets of Dragon in Mumbai
news.summary: Following a brief hiatus due to a shoulder injury, actor NTR is set to restart shooting for Prashanth Neel's directorial venture, Dragon, starting October 10 in Mumbai. A high-voltage action sequence spanning over two weeks has been planned for this schedule as the team aims to wrap up pending portions by the end of the year. The film also features Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon in prominent roles with music by Ravi Basrur.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is moving swiftly toward wrapping up his upcoming project, January 12 Vidudala, with a new schedule slated for Ooty in early October alongside overseas song shoots. The movie stars Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty, and is scheduled to hit theaters on January 12. Post-production is already underway with GV Prakash Kumar handling the background score and dubbing sessions having commenced.

news.title: Chakkora Theatrical Trailer Unveils a Twist-Filled Romantic Drama
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird, launched in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh, highlights a narrative blending romance, family emotions, and mystery. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie stars Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, and features a background score by Prince Henry. Backed by High Joy Commercials and VIP, the film is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Drop for Nitesh Tiwari's Upcoming Mythological Epic
news.summary: The makers of the highly anticipated Ramayana have released new promotional stills highlighting the lead cast members. Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey feature as the central trio in a serene natural setting, while Yash is revealed in a majestic avatar as Ravana. Backed by Prime Focus Studios and other production houses, Part 1 is slated to arrive in theaters for Diwali 2026.

news.title: Manga Srinivas Directs Upcoming Youthful Romance Chakkora
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has been unveiled by Aakash Jagannadh in Hyderabad. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the movie stars Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in pivotal roles with music composed by Prince Henry. The project is scheduled for a worldwide release on October 9 through Sri Lakshmi Pictures.
